decisions.reason: The concept has stayed visible after launch and has a quantified customer savings case, so for a growing firm this related modular offer still looks valuable to retain.

It remains actively presented and is close to the core product base, but the lack of visible performance evidence and possible overlap with newer shredder launches make it somewhat more pruneable than the flagship lines.
As a flagship modular line with continued website presence, quantified savings, and a named customer reference, it fits the firm's strategic direction and is very unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
Because this 2024 shredder line is new, close to the established business, and likely inexpensive to keep as an option while market feedback accumulates, management would usually continue it.
This new screen line extends the existing processing portfolio and, despite still-uncertain demand, its strategic fit and option value argue for keeping it on the market for now.
